name: Anakim
overview: The Anakim were a formidable race of giants inhabiting the land promised to Israel, described as men of great stature who caused fear among the spies sent to explore the land (Numbers 13:28, 13:32-33). Despite the intimidating presence of these giants and the fortified cities, Caleb demonstrated faith and courage, urging the people to possess the land with confidence in God's power (Numbers 13:30). Ultimately, under Joshua and Caleb's leadership, the Anakim were defeated, illustrating God's faithfulness in granting victory over seemingly insurmountable obstacles.
